caption_L1: Vaccination coverage in China from 1990 to 2019 , by vaccine is a line plot. The x-axis plots Year while the y-axis plots HepB3.
caption_L2L3: Vaccination figures for HepB3 were not recorded in China between 1990 and 2000. Vaccination coverage starts in 2000 at 0.6 increasing to 1.0 in 2010 where the level remains fairly static until 2019. The figures between 2000 and 2010 have limited data showing only one reference point at 2005. From 2010 onwards there appear to be more regular updates on the levels.
